sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Earlier this year, when much of the crypto world imploded and trillions of dollars disappeared, one company and its charismatic founder emerged as the industry's savior.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，当加密货币世界大部分崩溃、数万亿美元消失时，一家公司及其富有魅力的创始人成为了该行业的救世主。

sentences.en: Last week, that company collapsed.
sentences.zh: 上周，那家公司倒闭了。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague David Yafi
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事大卫·亚菲

sentences.en: Bellamy on the story of Sam Bankman Freed and why so many believed him.
sentences.zh: 贝拉米讲述了萨姆·班克曼-弗里德的故事，以及为什么那么多人相信他。

sentences.en: It's Friday, November 18th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月18日，星期五。

sentences.en: So David, the last time we had you on the show back in the spring, you told us about this big crypto crash.
sentences.zh: 那么大卫，上次你在春季做客我们的节目时，你告诉我们关于这次大型加密货币崩盘的消息。

sentences.en: And it was supposed to be a real reckoning for the crypto market.
sentences.zh: 那本应是加密货币市场的一次真正清算。

sentences.en: You know, trillions of dollars evaporating.
sentences.zh: 你知道，数万亿美元蒸发了。

sentences.en: And then the world kind of went on and we all kind of forgot about it.
sentences.zh: 然后世界就继续运转，我们也都快把它忘了。

sentences.en: But now you're back and you're going to talk with me today about crypto again and another crypto crash.
sentences.zh: 但现在你回来了，今天你要和我再次谈论加密货币和另一次加密货币崩盘。

sentences.en: Tell me what happened.
sentences.zh: 告诉我发生了什么。

sentences.en: So what happened in the spring was unquestionably very bad.
sentences.zh: 春季发生的事情无疑是非常糟糕的。

sentences.en: But what happened over the last week and a half was even worse.
sentences.zh: 但过去一周半发生的事情更糟糕。

sentences.en: And there are two reasons for that.
sentences.zh: 原因有二。

sentences.en: One is that this latest crash involves one of the biggest companies in the industry, a crypto exchange called FTX that was worth $32 billion.
sentences.zh: 一是这次最新的崩盘涉及业内最大的公司之一，一家名为 FTX 的加密货币交易所，其估值曾达320亿美元。

sentences.en: That was one of the most trusted companies in the industry, a place where customers
sentences.zh: 那是业内最受信任的公司之一，客户

sentences.en: would go to buy and sell cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ether, and also where they'd go to store their cryptocurrencies and trust that they were safe there.
sentences.zh: 会去那里买卖比特币和以太币等加密货币，也会去那里存储他们的加密货币，并相信它们在那里是安全的。

sentences.en: The other reason that this is different and even worse is that this whole story involves a guy named Sam Bankman Freed.
sentences.zh: 另一个让这次事件与众不同且更糟糕的原因是，整个故事涉及一个叫萨姆·班克曼-弗里德的人。

sentences.en: Sam Bankman Freed.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·班克曼-弗里德。

sentences.en: Sam Bankman Freed.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·班克曼-弗里德。

sentences.en: Sam Bankman Freed.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·班克曼-弗里德。

sentences.en: Sam Bankman Freed.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·班克曼-弗里德。

sentences.en: Sam Bankman Freed.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·班克曼-弗里德。

sentences.en: They call him the JP Morgan of crypto, right?
sentences.zh: 他们称他为加密界的摩根大通，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, the Michael Jordan of crypto, if you will.
sentences.zh: 是的，如果你愿意的话，他是加密界的迈克尔·乔丹。

sentences.en: He was a kind of crypto superhero, one of the most popular figures in the industry.
sentences.zh: 他曾是某种加密超级英雄，是业内最受欢迎的人物之一。

sentences.en: So, you know, we started a few years ago.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们几年前就开始了。

sentences.en: We're one of the newest of the large crypto platforMs.
sentences.zh: 我们是最新兴的大型加密平台之一。

sentences.en: Somebody who is kind of styling himself as a crypto diplomat.
sentences.zh: 一个把自己塑造成加密外交官的人。

sentences.en: And it's not a level playing field.
sentences.zh: 而且这不是一个公平的竞争环境。

sentences.en: And it's not an easy space to access.
sentences.zh: 而且这不是一个容易进入的空间。

sentences.en: The person who would take this technology into the mainstream.
sentences.zh: 那个将这项技术带入主流的人。

sentences.en: So I think like getting regulatory clarity is huge.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为获得监管透明度非常重要。

sentences.en: And I think it's good for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对每个人都有好处。

sentences.en: I think it helps regulators come up with rules to keep it under control.
sentences.zh: 我认为这有助于监管机构制定规则来控制它。

sentences.en: At the very least, I want to be doing something net positive.
sentences.zh: 至少，我想做一些净收益的事情。

sentences.en: And now it turns out that the business that he started was built on a house of cards.
sentences.zh: 现在看来，他创办的企业是建立在纸牌屋上的。

sentences.en: OK, so tell me about this guy, Sam Bankman Freed.
sentences.zh: 好吧，跟我说说这个人，萨姆·班克曼-弗里德。

sentences.en: How did he become this crypto superhero?
sentences.zh: 他是如何成为这个加密超级英雄的？

sentences.en: So he's the son of Stanford law professors, grew up in the Bay Area, ends up going to MIT for undergrad, majoring in physics.
sentences.zh: 他是斯坦福大学法学教授的儿子，在湾区长大，本科去了麻省理工学院，主修物理。

sentences.en: And he was always regarded as super smart.
sentences.zh: 他一直被认为非常聪明。

sentences.en: I mean, you talk to his classmates from back then, and they say that he was the kind of guy who didn't really have to work that hard
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你和当时他的同学交谈，他们说他就是那种不需要太努力工作的人，

sentences.en: because he could just show up on the day of the exam and get a good score.
sentences.zh: 因为他只要在考试当天出现就能拿到好成绩。

sentences.en: And, you know, like a lot of college students, he's trying to figure out what to do with his life.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，像许多大学生一样，他试图弄清楚自己的人生要做什么。

sentences.en: And the story that he's told over the years is that he wanted to do something good for the world.
sentences.zh: 多年来他讲述的故事是，他想为世界做点好事。

sentences.en: And he was trying to figure out how to channel that energy.
sentences.zh: 他试图弄清楚如何引导那种能量。

sentences.en: And he meets someone named Will McCaskill, a really kind of charismatic, smart philosopher who's an important figure in the world of effective altruism.
sentences.zh: 然后他遇到了一个叫威尔·麦卡斯基尔的人，一位非常有魅力、聪明的哲学家，是有效利他主义世界中的重要人物。

sentences.en: And remind me what that is.
sentences.zh: 提醒我那是什么。

sentences.en: That's a kind of charitable movement that emphasizes logic and reason and encourages people to give in as efficient a way as possible and to also give as much as they can.
sentences.zh: 那是一种慈善运动，强调逻辑和理性，鼓励人们以尽可能有效的方式捐赠，并尽可能多地捐赠。

sentences.en: And Will pitched Sam on something called Earn to Give.
sentences.zh: 威尔向萨姆推销了一种叫做“赚钱以捐赠”的理念。

sentences.en: And the idea behind that is that if you're a really smart and accomplished person and you want to do good in the world, instead of taking a low-paying job at a nonprofit
sentences.zh: 其背后的想法是，如果你是一个非常聪明和有成就的人，并且你想在世界上做好事，而不是在非营利组织做一份低薪工作

sentences.en: or doing community organizing, you should go off and just earn as much money as humanly possible so that you can give it all away.
sentences.zh: 或者从事社区组织工作，你应该去尽可能多地赚钱，这样你就可以把钱全部捐出去。

sentences.en: And in Sam's telling, he decides that he's going to try to dedicate his life to this idea.
sentences.zh: 按照萨姆的说法，他决定尝试将自己的一生奉献给这个想法。

sentences.en: After graduating, he goes to work for Jane Street, the quantitative trading firm.
sentences.zh: 毕业后，他去了量化交易公司简街资本工作。

sentences.en: And he's good at the job.
sentences.zh: 他很擅长这份工作。

sentences.en: He's a talented trader.
sentences.zh: 他是一位有天赋的交易员。

sentences.en: And he gives a big chunk of his salary every year.
sentences.zh: 他每年都会捐出很大一部分薪水。

sentences.en: And that's sort of how he kind of starts out in the world of finance.
sentences.zh: 这就是他开始进入金融世界的方式。

sentences.en: And when does he get into crypto?
sentences.zh: 他是什么时候进入加密货币领域的？

sentences.en: So after spending a while at Jane Street, he wants to strike out on his own.
sentences.zh: 在简街资本工作了一段时间后，他想自立门户。

sentences.en: And under this earn-to-give philosophy, he's looking for ways to make a lot of money really faSt.
sentences.zh: 在“赚钱以捐赠”的理念下，他正在寻找快速赚大钱的方法。

sentences.en: And what he settles on is the emerging world of crypto.
sentences.zh: 他最终选择了新兴的加密货币世界。

sentences.en: We're back in the kind of 2017 era, the first big cryptocurrency boom, tons of new tokens getting listed all the time.
sentences.zh: 我们回到了2017年左右，那是第一次大型加密货币繁荣，大量新代币不断上市。

sentences.en: And Sam decides he's going to dedicate himself to that.
sentences.zh: 萨姆决定投身于此。

sentences.en: So he starts a trading firm called Alameda Research.
sentences.zh: 于是他创办了一家名为 Alameda Research 的交易公司。

sentences.en: And it has a kind of crazed startup vibe.
sentences.zh: 它有一种疯狂的初创公司氛围。

sentences.en: They've got an office in Berkeley where people are sleeping.
sentences.zh: 他们在伯克利有一个办公室，人们在那里睡觉。

sentences.en: They're showering in the gym downstairs.
sentences.zh: 他们在楼下的健身房洗澡。

sentences.en: You know, Amazon boxes are piled up to the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 你知道，亚马逊的箱子堆到了天花板。

sentences.en: It has a really kind of like ragtag sort of thrown together rebel sort of feel to it.
sentences.zh: 它有一种非常破烂、拼凑起来的叛逆感。

sentences.en: And they're trying to make big trades.
sentences.zh: 他们试图进行大额交易。

sentences.en: And there's one trade in particular that eventually makes Sam kind of famous.
sentences.zh: 有一个特定的交易最终让萨姆出名了。

sentences.en: And what trade was that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么交易？

sentences.en: It hinged on a discrepancy between the price of Bitcoin in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 它取决于比特币在美国的价格

sentences.en: and its price in Japan.
sentences.zh: 和它在日本的价格之间的差异。

sentences.en: In Japan, Bitcoin costs about 10% more.
sentences.zh: 在日本，比特币的价格高出约10%。

sentences.en: And that presented a pretty straightforward arbitrage opportunity.
sentences.zh: 这提供了一个非常直接的套利机会。

sentences.en: Buy low, sell high.
sentences.zh: 低买高卖。

sentences.en: You know, get that Bitcoin in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在美国买入比特币，

sentences.en: and then sell it in Japan.
sentences.zh: 然后在日本卖掉它。

sentences.en: But as simple as that sounds, the details of pulling it off were really complicated.
sentences.zh: 但听起来很简单，执行细节却非常复杂。

sentences.en: Banks were super distrustful of crypto.
sentences.zh: 银行对加密货币非常不信任。

sentences.en: Sending wire transfers overseas took a long time.
sentences.zh: 向海外汇款需要很长时间。

sentences.en: You had to constantly be switching money across different types of currencies, across crypto and non-crypto.
sentences.zh: 你必须不断地在不同类型的货币之间、在加密货币和非加密货币之间转换资金。

sentences.en: It was an incredibly logistically complicated endeavor.
sentences.zh: 这是一项后勤极其复杂的任务。

sentences.en: And Sam's big triumph in the early days was that he figured out a way to execute this trade despite all those obstacles.
sentences.zh: 萨姆早期的巨大胜利在于，他想出了一种尽管有这些障碍也能执行此交易的方法。

sentences.en: And eventually, he's able to make a decent amount of money from this trade.
sentences.zh: 最终，他能够从这笔交易中赚到相当可观的钱。

sentences.en: And that's sort of the springboard for the rest of his career in the industry.
sentences.zh: 这就是他职业生涯其余部分在行业中的跳板。

sentences.en: And so that experience in the early world of crypto trading at Alameda Research gives Sam an idea.
sentences.zh: 因此，在 Alameda Research 早期加密货币交易世界的经历给了萨姆一个想法。

sentences.en: And the idea is to start a crypto exchange of his own.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是创办他自己的加密货币交易所。

sentences.en: One of these platforms for trading cryptocurrencies, but one that's simpler, easier, better run than all of the alternatives.
sentences.zh: 这些交易加密货币的平台之一，但要比所有替代方案更简单、更容易、运营得更好。

sentences.en: So he decides to move to Hong Kong and start a new company, a crypto exchange called FTX.
sentences.zh: 于是他决定搬到香港，创办一家新公司，一家名为 FTX 的加密货币交易所。

sentences.en: And the reason is pretty straightforward.
sentences.zh: 原因很简单。

sentences.en: The regulatory climate in Hong Kong is much more favorable to crypto companies than it is in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 香港的监管环境对加密货币公司比美国友好得多。

sentences.en: You know, he can offer a greater range of different types of cryptocurrencies.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他可以提供更多种类的加密货币。

sentences.en: And he can allow people to make kind of risky bets on the future prices of cryptocurrencies.
sentences.zh: 他可以让人们对比特币未来的价格进行某种风险押注。

sentences.en: This is called derivatives trading.
sentences.zh: 这被称为衍生品交易。

sentences.en: And basically, what it entails is that an individual investor can borrow money from the exchange so that they can just pile even more funds into the market,
sentences.zh: 基本上，它意味着个人投资者可以从交易所借钱，这样他们就可以向市场投入更多的资金，

sentences.en: which brings, you know, greater returns when the market's doing well, but also much greater losses when the market dips.
sentences.zh: 当市场表现良好时，这会带来更高的回报，但当市场下跌时，也会带来更大的损失。

sentences.en: But in both those scenarios, the fees are really high.
sentences.zh: 但在两种情况下，费用都非常高。

sentences.en: And the exchange collects that chunk of money on each transaction.
sentences.zh: 交易所从每笔交易中收取那部分钱。

sentences.en: And it's a super profitable way to run a business.
sentences.zh: 这是一种经营业务的超高利润方式。

sentences.en: So the exchange is both a place to trade, but it's also a lender.
sentences.zh: 所以交易所既是一个交易场所，也是一个借贷方。

sentences.en: The way it was set up by Sam Bankman-Fried, yes.
sentences.zh: 按照萨姆·班克曼-弗里德的设置方式，是的。

sentences.en: It would, you know, lend money out to customers so that they could make even bigger bets.
sentences.zh: 它会把钱借给客户，这样他们就可以进行更大的押注。

sentences.en: And in fact, he himself is participating in this kind of high leverage trading because his original company, Alameda Research, starts trading on this new FTX platform.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他自己也参与了这种高杠杆交易，因为他最初的公司 Alameda Research 开始在这个新的 FTX 平台上进行交易。

sentences.en: And of course,
sentences.zh: 当然，

sentences.en: that poses a bit of a conflict of interest because you've got a trading firm that's closely linked to the exchange that it's trading on that's trying to make money potentially at the expense of the exchange's other customers.
sentences.zh: 这构成了一定的利益冲突，因为你有一家与它进行交易的交易所紧密相连的交易公司，它可能以牺牲交易所其他客户为代价来赚钱。

sentences.en: But Sam waves off those concerns and says this whole operation is totally above board.
sentences.zh: 但萨姆对这些担忧不屑一顾，称整个运营完全合规。

sentences.en: So how does it go with this new exchange?
sentences.zh: 那么这个新交易所的情况如何？

sentences.en: What happens?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: It goes really well.
sentences.zh: 进展非常顺利。

sentences.en: And that's partly a matter of timing.
sentences.zh: 这部分是时机问题。

sentences.en: He starts the exchange in 2019.
sentences.zh: 他在2019年创办了该交易所。

sentences.en: And of course, in early 2020, we have the beginning of the pandemic, which ushers in a huge boom time for the crypto world.
sentences.zh: 当然，在2020年初，疫情开始了，这为加密货币世界带来了巨大的繁荣时期。

sentences.en: People are at home.
sentences.zh: 人们都在家里。

sentences.en: They're online all the time.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在线。

sentences.en: They're getting interested in these kind of weird investment vehicles that seem to be making a lot of money really faSt.
sentences.zh: 他们开始对这些看起来似乎能快速赚大钱的奇怪投资工具感兴趣。

sentences.en: And so they're flocking to exchanges like FTX.
sentences.zh: 所以他们蜂拥至像 FTX 这样的交易所。

sentences.en: But it's not just a matter of timing.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅仅是时机问题。

sentences.en: He's also really deliberate about marketing and trying to create viral moments for his new business.
sentences.zh: 他在营销方面也非常深思熟虑，试图为他的新业务创造病毒式传播的时刻。

sentences.en: Early on, he helps run a crypto conference where he distributes crypto-themed condoms with the FTX logo on them.
sentences.zh: 早期，他帮助举办了一场加密货币会议，在那里他分发了印有 FTX 标志的加密主题避孕套。

sentences.en: And jokes on the wrappers like never breaks even during large liquidations.
sentences.zh: 包装纸上还印着笑话，比如“在大规模清算期间从不破裂”。

sentences.en: Oh, God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And that marketing extends to himself as well.
sentences.zh: 而且这种营销手段也延伸到了他自己身上。

sentences.en: He tries to create a mystique for himself as a kind of nerd genius.
sentences.zh: 他试图为自己营造一种书呆子天才的神秘感。

sentences.en: He has this sort of disheveled appearance, wears T-shirts and shorts even into big meetings.
sentences.zh: 他总是那副邋里邋遢的样子，甚至在参加重要会议时也穿着T恤和短裤。

sentences.en: And it's all very calculated.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是经过精心算计的。

sentences.en: You know, when investors would show up to meet with him at the office, he'd be sleeping on a beanbag next to his desk.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当投资者到办公室见他时，他会睡在办公桌旁的懒人沙发上。

sentences.en: And the investors would be kind of shown into a conference room where they had a view of him sleeping so they could watch him slowly rouse himself and then walk into the meeting and kind of immediately turn on and deliver some,
sentences.zh: 投资者会被带进会议室，从那里可以看到他正在睡觉，这样他们就能看着他慢慢醒来，然后走进会议室，立刻进入状态，发表一些……

sentences.en: you know, cogent analysis of cryptocurrency markets.
sentences.zh: 你知道，关于加密货币市场的深刻分析。

sentences.en: You know, once a colleague of his said, Sam, you should really cut your hair before you go on TV.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他的同事对他说：“萨姆，你上电视前真的应该剪剪头发。”

sentences.en: And he said, no, it's in our interest for me to look super crazy and disheveled.
sentences.zh: 他说：“不，让我看起来超级疯狂和邋遢，对我们更有利。”

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It sounds like he understood that his image and his kind of genius boy persona was really part of what was selling his company.
sentences.zh: 听起来他明白，他的形象和那种天才少年的标签，确实是他公司营销的一部分。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: It was the brand.
sentences.zh: 这就是品牌效应。

sentences.en: And, you know, big name, respected venture capital firms get behind him.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那些大名鼎鼎、备受尊敬的风险投资公司都支持他。

sentences.en: You know, he seems like a kind of less scammy, more respectable version of a crypto tycoon.
sentences.zh: 他看起来像是加密货币大亨中那种不那么像骗子、更体面一点的版本。

sentences.en: And so the company gets bigger and bigger and Sam gets richer and richer.
sentences.zh: 于是公司越做越大，萨姆也越来越富有。

sentences.en: At one point, he's worth as much as $24 billion.
sentences.zh: 一度，他的身价高达240亿美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And what's he doing with all that money?
sentences.zh: 那他用这些钱做了什么呢？

sentences.en: I mean, is he doing what he said he would do, which is giving it away?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他是在做他承诺过的事情，也就是把钱捐出去吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, he's building a kind of idiosyncratic philanthropic empire.
sentences.zh: 是的，他正在建立一个独特的慈善帝国。

sentences.en: So he's funding research into artificial intelligence, for instance.
sentences.zh: 例如，他资助了人工智能研究。

sentences.en: He's, like, interested in, like, heading off potential existential threats to humanity.
sentences.zh: 他热衷于防范人类可能面临的生存威胁。

sentences.en: He's also doing things that people could probably relate to more easily, like funding research into pandemic preparedness efforts.
sentences.zh: 他也做一些人们更容易理解的事情，比如资助大流行病防范工作的研究。

sentences.en: You know, how do we stop the next big COVID outbreak and prevent people from dying?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们该如何阻止下一次大规模新冠疫情爆发，防止人们死亡？

sentences.en: But he's also getting into politics, donating a huge amount of money to major Democrats, $5 million to Joe Biden in the 2020 election effort,
sentences.zh: 但他同时也涉足政治，向民主党大佬捐赠了巨额资金，在2020年选举中向乔·拜登捐了500万美元，

sentences.en: which made him one of the president's top donors.
sentences.zh: 这使他成为总统最大的捐款人之一。

sentences.en: And why is he spending so much money on politics?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要花这么多钱在政治上？

sentences.en: So there are really a couple of reasons.
sentences.zh: 其实有几个原因。

sentences.en: One is because he does genuinely have these philanthropic priorities.
sentences.zh: 首先，他确实有这些慈善方面的优先事项。

sentences.en: You know, he wants to put people in power who will support his AI research and his pandemic preparedness research and all of that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他想让支持他的人工智能研究、大流行病防范研究以及所有这些项目的人掌权。

sentences.en: But, of course, this is also about shaping the future of crypto regulation,
sentences.zh: 但当然，这也是为了塑造加密货币监管的未来，

sentences.en: creating a landscape where he can do the sort of risky stuff that he does overseas in the United States as well and get even more powerful and make even more money.
sentences.zh: 创造一个环境，让他能在美国境内也进行他在海外从事的那种高风险业务，从而变得更强大，赚更多的钱。

sentences.en: And the only way to get away with that is to show up in Washington and convince regulators, convince lawmakers that it's appropriate.
sentences.zh: 而要实现这一点的唯一途径，就是出现在华盛顿，说服监管机构和立法者，让他们认为这是合理的。

sentences.en: And partly to that end, he moves his company in late 2021 from Hong Kong to the Bahamas.
sentences.zh: 为了这个目的，他在2021年底将公司从香港搬到了巴哈马。

sentences.en: You know, like Hong Kong, the Bahamas offers a pretty friendly regulatory environment where he can do all this stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道，和香港一样，巴哈马提供了一个相当友好的监管环境，让他可以做所有这些事情。

sentences.en: But it's also a great base if you want to be flying back and forth to the United States to try to shape policy.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想往返于美国以试图影响政策，这也是一个绝佳的基地。

sentences.en: And David, how does that go for him?
sentences.zh: 大卫，这对他的进展如何？

sentences.en: Does Washington buy it?
sentences.zh: 华盛顿买账吗？

sentences.en: It goes pretty well.
sentences.zh: 进展相当顺利。

sentences.en: You know, all of a sudden, Sam Bankman Freed is like a constant presence in D.C.
sentences.zh: 你知道，突然之间，萨姆·班克曼-弗里德成了华盛顿的常客。

sentences.en: He's meeting with big regulators.
sentences.zh: 他会见大监管机构。

sentences.en: He's meeting with lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 他会见立法者。

sentences.en: He's contributing to crypto-friendly bills that are getting proposed.
sentences.zh: 他为正在提议的加密货币友好法案做出贡献。

sentences.en: Thank you, Chair Sabnow, Ranking Member Bozeman and members of the committee.
sentences.zh: 谢谢萨布诺主席、博兹曼高级成员以及委员会的各位成员。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Bankman Freed, the CEO.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·班克曼-弗里德，首席执行官。

sentences.en: And he's even called to testify in front of Congress about the future of crypto regulation.
sentences.zh: 他甚至被传唤到国会，就加密货币监管的未来作证。

sentences.en: One of the big things that I want to point to in the digital asset industry is the equitable access that it provides to users.
sentences.zh: 我想在数字资产行业指出的重要一点是，它为用户提供了公平的准入机会。

sentences.en: And has some pretty friendly exchanges with lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 他还与立法者进行了一些相当友好的交流。

sentences.en: And so, Mr. Bankman Freed, I'm going to interrupt you because I've only got 30 seconds left.
sentences.zh: 那么，班克曼-弗里德先生，我要打断你一下，因为我只剩下30秒了。

sentences.en: And I'm offended that you have a much more glorious afro than I once had.
sentences.zh: 而且我很嫉妒，因为你的爆炸头比我曾经拥有的还要辉煌。

sentences.en: So it sounds like he's really become an ambassador for crypto.
sentences.zh: 听起来他真的成了加密货币的代言人。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: And, you know, both in and outside Washington, he also becomes this kind of crypto celebrity.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，无论是在华盛顿内外，他也成了这种加密货币名人。

sentences.en: And his goal is to make sure that everybody knows and trusts FTX.
sentences.zh: 他的目标是确保每个人都知道并信任FTX。

sentences.en: All right, it's official.
sentences.zh: 好了，正式宣布了。

sentences.en: The home of the Miami Heat is now FTX Arena.
sentences.zh: 迈阿密热火队的主场现在是FTX球馆。

sentences.en: Man, it's going to be hard to get used to saying that, though, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 伙计，习惯这么说会很难，不是吗？

sentences.en: He buys the naming rights to the Miami Heat's basketball arena.
sentences.zh: 他买下了迈阿密热火队篮球馆的冠名权。

sentences.en: I had to look it up because I didn't know what FTX was because he's got an FTX patch on the uniforms of the umpires in Major League Baseball.
sentences.zh: 我不得不去查了一下，因为我不知道FTX是什么，因为他在美国职业棒球大联盟裁判的制服上贴了FTX的补丁。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Patch meaning FTX is the umpire?
sentences.zh: 补丁的意思是FTX是裁判吗？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: We're the trusted person in the middle.
sentences.zh: 我们是中间值得信赖的人。

sentences.en: He's hanging out with celebrities and athletes.
sentences.zh: 他经常和名人和运动员混在一起。

sentences.en: Larry David's commercial for FTX generating a lot of buzz.
sentences.zh: 拉里·大卫为FTX拍摄的广告引起了很大轰动。

sentences.en: How about Tom Brady and his supermodel wife, Giselle, joining the cryptocurrency craze?
sentences.zh: 汤姆·布雷迪和他的超模妻子吉赛尔加入加密货币热潮怎么样？

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: What's up, guys?
sentences.zh: 嘿，伙计们，你们好吗？

sentences.en: I'm here with my boy Sam from FTX.
sentences.zh: 我和我的兄弟，来自FTX的萨姆在一起。

sentences.en: We're at Crypto Bahamas Conference.
sentences.zh: 我们在巴哈马加密货币大会上。

sentences.en: We're going to start...
sentences.zh: 我们要开始……

sentences.en: In April, he throws this huge party in the Bahamas.
sentences.zh: 四月份，他在巴哈马举办了这场盛大的派对。

sentences.en: You know, think beachside music, hand-rolled cigars, major political figures showing up to kind of laud him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，想象一下海边的音乐、手工卷制的雪茄，还有重要的政治人物出席来赞美他。

sentences.en: I'm convinced that we've got a lot of money, energy, and talent behind crypto.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们背后有大量的资金、精力和人才支持加密货币。

sentences.en: He does a talk with Bill Clinton and Tony Blair.
sentences.zh: 他和比尔·克林顿以及托尼·布莱尔进行了一场对话。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And when you have something that's obviously serious, you want to do right by it.
sentences.zh: 当你拥有某种显然很严肃的东西时，你会想把它做好。

sentences.en: In the regulatory space.
sentences.zh: 在监管领域。

sentences.en: Who basically say, this crypto stuff, it's really exciting.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上说，这些加密货币的东西，真的很令人兴奋。

sentences.en: And they're up on stage with Sam Bankman-Fried, who's in shorts and a t-shirt.
sentences.zh: 他们和穿着短裤和T恤的萨姆·班克曼-弗里德一起站在台上。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So that's a real height.
sentences.zh: 所以那是一个真正的高峰。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Not long after that conference in the Bahamas, actually, crypto starts to kind of fall apart.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在巴哈马那次会议后不久，加密货币就开始分崩离析了。

sentences.en: A few major projects collapse really quickly.
sentences.zh: 几个主要项目很快就崩溃了。

sentences.en: Obviously, that pushes down the prices of all the major cryptocurrencies.
sentences.zh: 显然，这压低了所有主要加密货币的价格。

sentences.en: But FTX appears, at least outwardly, to be doing relatively well amid all of this volatility in crypto markets.
sentences.zh: 但FTX在加密货币市场的这种波动中，至少表面上看起来表现得相对不错。

sentences.en: Sam still seems to be really rich.
sentences.zh: 萨姆看起来依然非常富有。

sentences.en: He's actually spending money to bail out failing crypto companies.
sentences.zh: 他实际上还在花钱救助那些濒临倒闭的加密货币公司。

sentences.en: And he's sort of hailed as a savior, actually.
sentences.zh: 他甚至被誉为救世主。

sentences.en: You know, somebody who's the kind of last support between the crypto industry and, like, total collapse, basically.
sentences.zh: 你知道，某种程度上是加密行业和彻底崩溃之间的最后一道防线。

sentences.en: But, of course, this was a massive crash that hurt everybody in the industry.
sentences.zh: 但当然，这是一场巨大的崩盘，伤害了行业里的每一个人。

sentences.en: And nobody fully escaped the fallout.
sentences.zh: 没有人能完全逃脱余波。

sentences.en: Not even Sam Bankman-Fried.
sentences.zh: 连萨姆·班克曼-弗里德也不例外。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: So, David, you said that the contagion in the crypto market eventually caught up with Sam Bankman-Fried.
sentences.zh: 那么，大卫，你说加密市场的传染最终波及到了萨姆·班克曼-弗里德。

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: So it's been a pretty wild week and a half.
sentences.zh: 这过去的一周半非常疯狂。

sentences.en: One of the busiest of my reporting career.
sentences.zh: 是我报道生涯中最忙碌的一段时间之一。

sentences.en: And basically the sequence of events begins in early November.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这一系列事件始于11月初。

sentences.en: Fast-moving developments with crypto and FTX last week.
sentences.zh: 上周加密货币和FTX的发展节奏非常快。

sentences.en: It boggles the mind.
sentences.zh: 令人难以置信。

sentences.en: If you blinked, you missed it.
sentences.zh: 如果你眨一下眼，就会错过它。

sentences.en: When a crypto publication called Coindesk obtains a balance sheet associated with Alameda Research, Sam's trading firm.
sentences.zh: 当一家名为Coindesk的加密货币出版物获得了一份与萨姆的交易公司Alameda Research相关的资产负债表时。

sentences.en: But Coindesk published an article saying that Alameda Research, which is another company owned by Sam Bankman-Fried,
sentences.zh: 但Coindesk发表了一篇文章称，萨姆·班克曼-弗里德拥有的另一家公司Alameda Research，

sentences.en: had essentially more than $5 or $6 billion of FTT tokens on its balance sheet.
sentences.zh: 其资产负债表上基本上有超过50亿或60亿美元的FTT代币。

sentences.en: And the balance sheet basically shows that, you know, Alameda is kind of on shaky foundations.
sentences.zh: 而资产负债表基本上显示，你知道，Alameda的基础有点摇摇欲坠。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of its assets are sort of tied up in sort of fake-sounding cryptocurrencies.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它的许多资产都被某种听起来很假的加密货币所捆绑。

sentences.en: And it might not have as much real money as it thinks.
sentences.zh: 它可能没有它想象中那么多的真金白银。

sentences.en: So you've just seen the same fears we saw with crypto markets in the spring now coming to roost with Sam Bankman-Fried.
sentences.zh: 所以你刚刚看到的，正是我们在春季加密货币市场上看到的同样的恐惧，现在在萨姆·班克曼-弗里德身上重演了。

sentences.en: And then the big picture here is...
sentences.zh: 而这里的大背景是……

sentences.en: And this sort of stuff comes up in crypto all the time.
sentences.zh: 这种事情在加密货币领域经常发生。

sentences.en: And oftentimes, big crypto advocates will just dismiss it.
sentences.zh: 而且通常情况下，加密货币的大力支持者只会对此不屑一顾。

sentences.en: They'll say this is people spreading misinformation, trying to discourage, you know, growth in the industry.
sentences.zh: 他们会说这是有人在散布虚假信息，试图阻碍行业的发展。

sentences.en: But what makes this different is that someone really influential weighs in on the debate.
sentences.zh: 但这次不同的是，一个非常有影响力的人介入了这场辩论。

sentences.en: A guy named Chengpeng Zhao, who runs Binance, which is another crypto exchange and one of FTX's biggest rivals.
sentences.zh: 一个叫赵长鹏的人，他经营着币安，这是另一家加密货币交易所，也是FTX最大的竞争对手之一。

sentences.en: And what does he say?
sentences.zh: 他说了什么？

sentences.en: About two weeks ago on a Sunday, Chengpeng Zhao takes to Twitter and says, essentially, these rumors that FTX is in trouble, I believe them.
sentences.zh: 大约两周前的一个周日，赵长鹏在推特上说，基本上，关于FTX陷入困境的传言，我相信是真的。

sentences.en: And you shouldn't trust this company.
sentences.zh: 你不应该信任这家公司。

sentences.en: And that almost immediately sets off what amounts to a crypto version of a bank run.
sentences.zh: 这几乎立即引发了一场加密货币版的银行挤兑。

sentences.en: Customers who've got their funds locked up in FTX are rushing to get the stuff out.
sentences.zh: 在FTX存有资金的客户正争先恐后地把钱取出来。

sentences.en: You know, billions of dollars in crypto are leaving FTX's platform practically overnight.
sentences.zh: 你知道，数十亿美元的加密货币几乎在一夜之间离开了FTX平台。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: This is continuing on Monday.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在周一还在继续。

sentences.en: And Sam's trying to calm everybody down.
sentences.zh: 萨姆试图让大家冷静下来。

sentences.en: He goes on Twitter and says, FTX is fine, assets are fine, I really respect my rival, but he's wrong on this, and we need to work together for the future of the industry.
sentences.zh: 他在推特上说，FTX很好，资产很好，我非常尊重我的竞争对手，但他在这件事上错了，我们需要为了行业的未来共同努力。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: That's Monday.
sentences.zh: 那是周一。

sentences.en: The next day, Tuesday, Sam tweets the exact opposite.
sentences.zh: 第二天，周二，萨姆发了完全相反的推文。

sentences.en: We're going to dive into this, but I think we can safely say that this is a hinge event in the crypto economy.
sentences.zh: 我们要深入探讨这个问题，但我认为我们可以肯定地说，这是加密经济中的一个转折性事件。

sentences.en: Our company is in total crisis.
sentences.zh: 我们的公司陷入了全面危机。

sentences.en: It's imploding, and I'm going to be selling it to Chengpeng Zhao at Binance, his rival, his rival.
sentences.zh: 它正在崩溃，我将把它卖给我的竞争对手，币安的赵长鹏。

sentences.en: Binance and FTX are two of the biggest exchanges out there.
sentences.zh: 币安和FTX是目前最大的两家交易所。

sentences.en: So if you combine Binance and FTX, it makes for a big player in this market.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你把币安和FTX合并，它会成为这个市场上的一个大玩家。

sentences.en: And so everybody thought, okay, things will be roughly fine.
sentences.zh: 所以每个人都以为，好吧，事情大概会好起来。

sentences.en: We'll get this big super exchange, you know, Binance slash FTX, and everybody's money will be fine.
sentences.zh: 我们会得到这个大型超级交易所，你知道，币安加FTX，每个人的钱都会没事的。

sentences.en: But then the next day, Wednesday, Binance pulls out of the deal almost as fast as it had come together.
sentences.zh: 但第二天，周三，币安退出交易的速度几乎和它达成交易时一样快。

sentences.en: The deal's off.
sentences.zh: 交易取消了。

sentences.en: I think they took a look at it and just decided this was a hole too big to fill.
sentences.zh: 我想他们看了一眼，就决定这个窟窿太大了，填不上。

sentences.en: So suddenly, Sam is starting to run out of options.
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间，萨姆开始走投无路了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: He's scrambling for new financing.
sentences.zh: 他正在四处筹集新资金。

sentences.en: And that lasts for about a day.
sentences.zh: 但这也就持续了一天左右。

sentences.en: You know, he's doing that on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他在周四还在做这件事。

sentences.en: And then Friday morning, there's a big announcement.
sentences.zh: 然后周五早上，就发布了一个重大公告。

sentences.en: Sam Bankman-Fried stepping down as CEO of FTX as his crypto exchange files for bankruptcy.
sentences.zh: 山姆·班克曼-弗里德辞去FTX首席执行官职务，他的加密货币交易所申请破产。

sentences.en: FTX is bankrupt.
sentences.zh: FTX破产了。

sentences.en: Sam's resigning as CEO.
sentences.zh: 山姆辞去了首席执行官的职务。

sentences.en: And the future of everybody's money will be settled in court.
sentences.zh: 而每个人资金的未来将由法庭裁决。

sentences.en: So in the span of just a week, Sam goes from this shining star of the industry to bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 所以仅仅在一周之内，山姆就从这个行业的闪亮明星变成了破产者。

sentences.en: But what happened to the money people were trying to get out of FTX?
sentences.zh: 但是人们试图从FTX取出的钱到底去哪了？

sentences.en: So this goes back to Sam's original business, Alameda Research.
sentences.zh: 这要追溯到山姆最初的企业，Alameda Research。

sentences.en: Alameda never went anywhere.
sentences.zh: Alameda从未消失。

sentences.en: It was still trading and trading heavily on the FTX platform.
sentences.zh: 它仍在交易，而且在FTX平台上进行着大规模交易。

sentences.en: And this was always something that bothered people.
sentences.zh: 这一直以来都是让人困扰的问题。

sentences.en: It seemed unfair that a company that's trying to make money trading was run by kind of roughly the same people in charge of the marketplace where the company is doing the trading.
sentences.zh: 一家试图通过交易赚钱的公司，却由负责该交易平台的同一批人管理，这似乎很不公平。

sentences.en: But what we've learned over the last few days from conversations with ex-employees, conversations with other people who are close to FTX,
sentences.zh: 但我们从过去几天与前员工的谈话，以及与FTX关系密切的其他人的谈话中了解到，

sentences.en: was that around the time of that crash in May, Alameda got itself into big trouble.
sentences.zh: 大约在五月份那次崩盘时，Alameda陷入了巨大的麻烦。

sentences.en: It had been taking out loans over the months and using that borrowed money to invest in other crypto companies, to do all sorts of risky trading.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，它一直在借款，并利用这些借来的钱投资其他加密货币公司，进行各种高风险交易。

sentences.en: But when the crypto market crashed, those lenders suddenly wanted their money back.
sentences.zh: 但当加密货币市场崩盘时，那些贷款人突然要求还钱。

sentences.en: They called up Alameda and they said, you've got to pay us back right away.
sentences.zh: 他们打电话给Alameda说，你们必须马上还钱。

sentences.en: But those funds were tied up in all those kinds of risky ventures that Alameda had poured them into.
sentences.zh: 但这些资金被套在了Alameda投入的各种高风险项目中。

sentences.en: Alameda couldn't get the money back.
sentences.zh: Alameda拿不回钱。

sentences.en: They couldn't get the money back fast enough to deal with their creditors.
sentences.zh: 他们无法足够快地收回资金来应对债权人。

sentences.en: And it's at that moment we've now learned that Sam and several of his top executives at FTX did something that ended up destroying the company.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，我们现在得知，山姆和他在FTX的几位高管做了一件事，最终摧毁了公司。

sentences.en: What they did is that they dipped into the customer funds stored on FTX, those deposits of Bitcoin and Ether that regular traders had put onto the platform.
sentences.zh: 他们做的是动用了存储在FTX上的客户资金，也就是普通交易者存入平台的比特币和以太币。

sentences.en: They took that money and they lent it out to Alameda.
sentences.zh: 他们拿走了那笔钱，并借给了Alameda。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And Alameda used that money to pay back the loans.
sentences.zh: 而Alameda用这笔钱偿还了贷款。

sentences.en: So basically, Sam Bankman-Fried decided to take money from his exchange to pay the debts of the other company.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，山姆·班克曼-弗里德决定从他的交易所拿钱来偿还另一家公司的债务。

sentences.en: But I don't really get it, David.
sentences.zh: 但我还是不太明白，大卫。

sentences.en: Like, if the whole problem was Alameda, like all the risky investments it had made, why not just let it fail?
sentences.zh: 如果整个问题出在Alameda身上，比如它所做的所有高风险投资，为什么不直接让它倒闭呢？

sentences.en: Like, at this point, you know, Sam Bankman-Fried is worth billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，你知道，山姆·班克曼-弗里德身家数十亿。

sentences.en: Why risk that to keep your first business alive?
sentences.zh: 为什么要冒着风险去维持你的第一家公司呢？

sentences.en: These companies are so closely entangled.
sentences.zh: 这些公司纠缠得太深了。

sentences.en: If Alameda had failed, that would have been a huge reputational hit for FTX.
sentences.zh: 如果Alameda倒闭，那对FTX的声誉将是巨大的打击。

sentences.en: You know, it would have reduced customer confidence in the platform.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这会降低客户对该平台的信心。

sentences.en: And so the two institutions were basically inseparable.
sentences.zh: 所以这两家机构基本上是不可分割的。

sentences.en: And there's another potential reason, though this one's more speculative.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个潜在原因，尽管这个原因更具推测性。

sentences.en: Alameda was run by a woman named Caroline Ellison, who was one of Sam's original hires when he started the company.
sentences.zh: Alameda由一位名叫卡罗琳·埃里森的女性管理，她是山姆创办公司时最初聘用的人之一。

sentences.en: And at times over the years, Sam and Caroline had been romantically involved.
sentences.zh: 多年来，山姆和卡罗琳曾有过一段恋情。

sentences.en: In the Bahamas, they even lived together in this massive sort of palatial suite with a bunch of other roommates who worked at FTX.
sentences.zh: 在巴哈马，他们甚至和一群也在FTX工作的室友住在一起，住在一个巨大的宫殿般的套房里。

sentences.en: And so, both personally and professionally, you know, Sam was incredibly entangled with the world of Alameda.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论是在个人生活还是职业生涯中，你知道，山姆都与Alameda的世界紧密纠缠在一起。

sentences.en: Thinking broadly about this, I mean, how should I understand what happened?
sentences.zh: 从宏观角度思考这个问题，我的意思是，我该如何理解所发生的一切？

sentences.en: Was he knowingly doing something that was illegal?
sentences.zh: 他是明知故犯吗？

sentences.en: Or was he just bumbling and sloppy?
sentences.zh: 还是他只是笨手笨脚、马虎大意？

sentences.en: There was nothing illegal about those unwise investments, as lots of people in crypto have learned.
sentences.zh: 那些不明智的投资本身并不违法，正如许多加密货币圈内人所了解的那样。

sentences.en: It is perfectly legal to throw your money at something that's worthless and then, you know, have trouble paying back loans.
sentences.zh: 把钱投向毫无价值的东西，然后发现难以偿还贷款，这完全是合法的。

sentences.en: It was what happened subsequently that is getting Sam into a lot of trouble and which may well have been a criminal act that could put him in prison eventually.
sentences.zh: 正是随后发生的事情让山姆陷入了巨大的麻烦，这很可能是一种犯罪行为，最终可能会让他入狱。

sentences.en: Taking those user funds and using them to plug the hole in Alameda.
sentences.zh: 拿走那些用户资金，并用它们来填补Alameda的窟窿。

sentences.en: That's what set up the problems that came up with the bank run.
sentences.zh: 正是这一点引发了后来出现的挤兑问题。

sentences.en: You know, customer deposits weren't safe.
sentences.zh: 你知道，客户存款并不安全。

sentences.en: They'd been recklessly transferred over to another company.
sentences.zh: 它们被鲁莽地转移到了另一家公司。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's what has made so many people in the crypto industry so angry.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这就是让加密货币行业中那么多人如此愤怒的原因。

sentences.en: It feels like this incredible betrayal that this guy who cast himself as a trustworthy, responsible figure was essentially gambling with his customers' money.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是一种难以置信的背叛，这个把自己塑造成值得信赖、负责任形象的人，实际上是在拿客户的钱赌博。

sentences.en: And how much money was that?
sentences.zh: 那到底有多少钱？

sentences.en: So we know that when customers rushed to withdraw funds and FTX had to freeze withdrawals because they just didn't have the money available,
sentences.zh: 我们知道，当客户蜂拥提款，而FTX不得不冻结提款，因为他们根本没有足够的资金时，

sentences.en: that the hole that FTX was facing was about $8 billion.
sentences.zh: FTX面临的窟窿大约是80亿美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That's a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 那可是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: And David, has he been talking?
sentences.zh: 大卫，他有回应吗？

sentences.en: Like, has he said anything about all of this?
sentences.zh: 比如，他有没有就这一切说过什么？

sentences.en: So surprisingly for somebody who's in the middle of a legal and corporate firestorm,
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，对于一个正处于法律和企业风暴中心的人来说，

sentences.en: he's been reasonably chatty with reporters, you know, responding to text messages throughout the week and that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 他与记者的交流相当频繁，你知道，整个星期都在回复短信之类的东西。

sentences.en: I, like many of my colleagues, texted him while this was starting to heat up and said,
sentences.zh: 我和我的许多同事一样，在事情开始升温时给他发了短信，说，

sentences.en: Sam, you want to get on the phone?
sentences.zh: 山姆，你想通个电话吗？

sentences.en: I have some questions for you.
sentences.zh: 我有一些问题要问你。

sentences.en: And he kind of expressed some vague willingness to talk.
sentences.zh: 他表达了一些模糊的谈话意愿。

sentences.en: And then late on Sunday night.
sentences.zh: 然后是在周日深夜。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I guess, I guess the first thing I'm wondering about.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我想，我想我首先想知道的是。

sentences.en: I got a phone call from him.
sentences.zh: 我接到了他的电话。

sentences.en: Like, at what point did you realize that this was going to be a big issue?
sentences.zh: 比如，你在什么时候意识到这将成为一个大问题？

sentences.en: I asked him.
sentences.zh: 我问他。

sentences.en: Can you explain on the record how big the margin position that Alameda held on FTX was?
sentences.zh: 你能公开解释一下Alameda在FTX持有的保证金头寸有多大吗？

sentences.en: Do you think that was a problem that you were in a romantic relationship with, Caroline?
sentences.zh: 你认为你和卡罗琳的恋爱关系是个问题吗？

sentences.en: Are you afraid about the possibility of jail time?
sentences.zh: 你害怕坐牢的可能性吗？

sentences.en: Did that constitute lending out customer funds, essentially, and putting customer funds at risk?
sentences.zh: 这是否构成了挪用客户资金，本质上是将客户资金置于风险之中？

sentences.en: Frustratingly, it was difficult to get him to say much on the record.
sentences.zh: 令人沮丧的是，很难让他公开说些什么。

sentences.en: You know, what he did say was not super satisfying.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他所说的内容并不令人满意。

sentences.en: It didn't really answer any of the questions kind of hanging over this whole situation.
sentences.zh: 它并没有真正回答笼罩在整个局势上的任何问题。

sentences.en: In retrospect, I wish that, I wish we'd bitten off a lot less.
sentences.zh: 回想起来，我希望，我希望我们当初能少做一点。

sentences.en: His basic story was that he'd built this huge crypto empire and kind of lost control of it.
sentences.zh: 他的基本说法是，他建立了一个庞大的加密货币帝国，但失去了控制。

sentences.en: And, you know, when I asked him about the billions of dollars that FTX was missing, the customer deposits that they couldn't return, he basically said,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当我问他关于FTX缺失的数十亿美元，即他们无法归还的客户存款时，他基本上说，

sentences.en: oh, you know, I knew that we had lent some money to Alameda, but I wasn't totally sure how much, and my estimate was off by billions.
sentences.zh: 哦，你知道，我知道我们借了一些钱给Alameda，但我不太确定具体是多少，我的估计差了数十亿。

sentences.en: Off by billions, as in off by $8 billion?
sentences.zh: 差了数十亿，是指差了80亿美元吗？

sentences.en: Off by as much as $8 billion.
sentences.zh: 差了多达80亿美元。

sentences.en: So he had no idea what was going on.
sentences.zh: 所以他根本不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: He claiMs.
sentences.zh: 他声称。

sentences.en: That's his claim.
sentences.zh: 那是他的说法。

sentences.en: Now, of course, it's a convenient explanation in some ways.
sentences.zh: 当然，这在某种程度上是一个方便的解释。

sentences.en: It relieves him of some level of responsibility, and I think it's probably a preview of the sort of legal argument that he might try to make as he defends himself,
sentences.zh: 它减轻了他某种程度的责任，我认为这很可能是他在为自己辩护时可能尝试提出的法律论点的前奏，

sentences.en: and so you've got to take it with a big grain of salt.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须对它持保留态度。

sentences.en: But even since my conversation with him, a huge amount of damaging information has come out about FTX, that it didn't really have accounting procedures,
sentences.zh: 但即使在我与他交谈之后，关于FTX的大量破坏性信息也浮出水面，它根本没有会计程序，

sentences.en: that its human resources department was a complete mess.
sentences.zh: 它的人力资源部门简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: In fact, in bankruptcy court recently, the new chief executive of FTX, a kind of restructuring expert who oversaw the Enron bankruptcy,
sentences.zh: 事实上，最近在破产法庭上，FTX的新任首席执行官，一位曾监督安然破产案的重组专家，

sentences.en: came to court and said that he'd never seen a mess like this in his career.
sentences.zh: 来到法庭说，他在职业生涯中从未见过这样的烂摊子。

sentences.en: Wow, that's saying something.
sentences.zh: 哇，那可是相当严重了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's the Enron guy saying that he's never seen anything like this.
sentences.zh: 那是安然公司的人说他从未见过这样的事情。

sentences.en: So if his business turned out to be just as shaky and, of course, potentially even fraudulent, why did so many reputable people in Washington and finance believe him?
sentences.zh: 所以如果他的生意结果如此摇摇欲坠，当然，甚至可能存在欺诈，为什么华盛顿和金融界的那么多知名人士会相信他？

sentences.en: A lot of it had to do with privilege.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上与特权有关。

sentences.en: You know, Sam came from this fancy academic background.
sentences.zh: 你知道，山姆有着显赫的学术背景。

sentences.en: He spoke the same language as the people who were giving him money.
sentences.zh: 他与那些给他钱的人说着同样的语言。

sentences.en: And so he managed to avoid some of the questions that might have been asked of people with a different set of characteristics and different stuff on their resume.
sentences.zh: 因此，他成功地避免了一些本可能被问及那些具有不同背景和简历的人的问题。

sentences.en: But that wasn't the only thing.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是唯一的原因。

sentences.en: I think a lot of this also comes down to greed.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很大程度上也归结于贪婪。

sentences.en: The investors who gave him money, the politicians who accepted his money, they all saw, you know, dollar signs around Sam Bankman Freed.
sentences.zh: 给他钱的投资者，接受他钱的政客，他们都看到了，你知道，山姆·班克曼-弗里德身上的美元符号。

sentences.en: And that was really the foundational sin of crypto in 2021.
sentences.zh: 那确实是2021年加密货币的原罪。

sentences.en: Everything was going so well.
sentences.zh: 一切都进展得太顺利了。

sentences.en: The markets were spiking.
sentences.zh: 市场在飙升。

sentences.en: There were all these kind of opportunities to profit.
sentences.zh: 有各种各样的获利机会。

sentences.en: And people were willing to look the other way while the money kept flowing.
sentences.zh: 当资金不断涌入时，人们愿意视而不见。

sentences.en: Like he gave them permission to do it.
sentences.zh: 就像他给了他们这样做的许可。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He gave them permission.
sentences.zh: 他给了他们许可。

sentences.en: And he was aware of that.
sentences.zh: 而且他意识到了这一点。

sentences.en: He was so conscious of how he was packaging himself.
sentences.zh: 他非常清楚自己是如何包装自己的。

sentences.en: He knew exactly what strings to pull to get people to give him money.
sentences.zh: 他完全知道该拉动哪些弦来让人们给他钱。

sentences.en: And as he's said a little bit more publicly over the last few days, he's expressed a pretty explicit level of cynicism about this whole project,
